summary: REQ-7, REQ-9, and REQ-10 appear implemented: consultation section shows the specified phone/email and includes a WhatsApp link; footer includes the specified phone/email and a WhatsApp link. REQ-8 is only partially satisfied because the global floating WhatsApp CTA is icon-only and may not meet the “clearly labeled”/visible label acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: A visible WhatsApp button exists on the site and is clearly labeled for WhatsApp chat.
missing_requirements.reason: The added floating WhatsApp button uses only an icon (MessageCircle) with an aria-label, but no visible text label indicating WhatsApp chat. This may fail the AC requirement for a clearly labeled, visible WhatsApp button.
